{{Quote|Ridge, your comm's gone static.''"<br />"''Got it.|A clone trooper, to Ridge, before the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]]|audio=RidgeStatic-TCWf.flac|<ref name="TCWfilm" />}}
'''Ridge''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Ridge was dispatched with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Company/Legends|unit]] [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teth/Legends|Teth]] to recover the [[Hutt/Legends|Huttlet]] [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]], in order to gain access to [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace routes]] controlled by [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], for the Republic [[Army/Legends|Army]]. As the Republic [[Troop/Legends|troops]] arrived at Teth in their [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] forces stationed there opened fire, forcing the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|gunships]] to land. The ensuing [[Battle of Teth/Legends|battle]] resulted in the rescue of Rotta, but came at the expense of the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of Ridge and all but six of Torrent Company's [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]].

==Biography==
The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who adopted the name Ridge<ref name="TCWfilm" /> was one of the many [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="clone troopers">{{DB|organization|clonetroopers|clone troopers}}</ref> raised on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]<ref name="SWE" /> to fight for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="clone troopers" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Ridge was part of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], serving under [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] in [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]], a [[Company/Legends|unit]] of the Republic's famed [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]].<ref name="TCWnovel" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> Ridge and Torrent Company were deployed to rescue [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] son, [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Huttlet]], on the planet of [[Teth/Legends|Teth]], in order to gain access to [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace routes]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] controlled by Jabba for the Grand Army of the Republic. Along with Rex, Skywalker, and the latter's newly assigned [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], Ridge traveled in a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] to the planet surface. During the flight, another trooper informed Ridge that [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] had a malfunction, and Ridge quickly corrected it.<ref name="TCWfilm" />

The Confederate forces on Teth kept Rotta captive within an [[B'omarr Monastery|old monastery]],<ref name="TCWfilm" /> which sat on a half-mile high mesa.<ref name="TCWVG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> The [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|gunships]] were fired upon by the Confederate [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces as they descended, however, forcing them to land under the monastery and deploy their troops to climb up the cliff face of the mesa.<ref name="TCWfilm" /> In the ensuing [[Battle of Teth/Legends|battle]], Ridge was [[Death/Legends|killed]]. Although Skywalker was ultimately able to retrieve and [[Mission to Jabba's Palace (Clone Wars)/Legends|return]] Rotta to his father, all but six of Torrent Company's clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] died at Teth.<ref name="TCWnovel" /><ref name="TCWfilm" />

==Personality and traits==
Ridge was a loyal clone trooper and obeyed the orders given to him. When his comlink malfunctioned, he was able to repair it quickly.<ref name="TCWfilm" /> Like all Fett clones,<ref name="clone troopers" /> Ridge was 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="SWE" />

==Equipment==
Ridge wore [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] in combat.<ref name="TCWfilm" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ridge first appeared as a background character in the [[2008]] film [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']]. He, like all clone troopers in the film, was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="TCWfilm" />
